newsitem.title: JAPAN: Reactors in southern Japan unaffected by quake.
newsitem.headline: Reactors in southern Japan unaffected by quake.

text.p: Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc said that its nuclear power plant operations were not affected by a strong earthquake which hit Japan's southern island of Kyushu on Tuesday.
"Our reactors are running normally, and there is no radiation leakage at the plants," a company spokesman said.
The earthquake registered 6.1 on the Richter scale and was centred near the city of Sendai in Kagoshima Prefecture, on the southwestern part of the island, Japan's Meterological Agency said.
Kyushu Electric operates two reactors at its Sendai nuclear power plant in Kagoshima and three at its Genkai nuclear power plant in Saga Prefecture in northern Kyushu.
